resolved_findings: Prune source baseline must itself be preserved; arbitrary partial/empty ranges cannot prove content.
Deletion exclusion survives removal and participates in supported start paths; lock inside deleted cache is insufficient.
Installation proof has explicit strict exact-version manifest input and checks both resolved and loaded versions.
Authoritative merge SHA may equal head; inferred/copied head is not authoritative proof.
